subject: Inquiry regarding accessing raw accelerometer from UK Biobank

messages.author: b393c281bb78608e
messages.subject: Inquiry regarding accessing raw accelerometer from UK Biobank
parts:
Dear Vincent,

Hello! I am very sorry to bother you in your busy schedule. Recently I hope to use the raw accelerometer data (Field ID : 90001) from UK Biobank to derive some parameters regarding physiccal activity. And I have obtained the data of sas form (.sas7bdat) listing many variables including 90001. Other variables are visible directly but I cannot view or open the data of 90001 in this sas file when click. I know that 90001 is a .cwa file, so I’m asking for your help. Is there anything wrong with my dataset or file form? How can I get the raw accelerometer data from this file? Can we ordinary users of UKB access this raw accelerometer data or need more specialized application to UK Biobank?

Thank you for your kind consideration. Looking forward to your earliest reply.
